effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Baizhi memerintahkan You'tan untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description: Baizhi terus mengonsumsi STA untuk memerintahkan You'tan menyerang musuh, memberikan  Glacio DMG. Selama Heavy Attack, Baizhi dapat mengarahkan You'tan untuk bergerak.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Baizhi mengonsumsi STA dan memanggil You’tan di udara untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan  Glacio DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah berhasil dodge untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Glacio DMG.
Baizhi memanggil You'tan untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Glacio DMG sambil langsung menyembuhkan semua karakter di tim terdekat.
Baizhi memanggil You'tan untuk menyembuhkan semua karakter di tim terdekat, menghasilkan 4 stack Remnant Entities.

effects.title: Remnant Entities
effects.description: Remnant Entities mengikuti anggota tim yang sedang aktif. 1 stack Remnant Entities akan otomatis dikonsumsi setiap 2.5 detik untuk melakukan Coordinated Attack, memberikan  Glacio DMG saat mengenai musuh sambil menyembuhkan semua karakter di tim jika karakter aktif berada dalam jangkauan.

effects.title: You'tan
effects.description: Makhluk Remnant yang merespons pikiran dan keinginan Baizhi serta berbagi semua stat miliknya. You'tan akan kembali ke Baizhi ketika Baizhi melakukan Dodge.

effects.title: Concentration
effects.description:
Baizhi mengonsumsi semua Concentration saat menggunakan Heavy Attack atau Resonance Skill Emergency Plan untuk terus menyembuhkan semua Resonator di tim terdekat. Setiap 1 Concentration yang dikonsumsi memberikan 1 kali pemulihan. Pemulihan terjadi setiap 2 detik.
- Saat Baizhi mengonsumsi Concentration untuk menggunakan Heavy Attack, Baizhi juga memulihkan Concerto Energy dan Resonance Energy.
- Saat Baizhi mengonsumsi Concentration untuk menggunakan Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, Baizhi juga memulihkan Concerto Energy.

effects.title: Forte Gauge: Concentration
effects.description:
- Baizhi dapat menampung hingga 4 Concentration.
- Baizhi mendapatkan 1 Concentration setiap kali Basic Attack mengenai target.
Saat Baizhi menggunakan Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, You'tan menciptakan Euphonia Field yang bertahan selama 15 detik.
Saat mengenai target, Heavy Attack Baizhi menyembuhkan karakter dengan HP terendah di tim terdekat sebesar 0.25% dari Max HP Baizhi.
Baizhi memanggil You'tan untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan  Glacio DMG sambil menyembuhkan semua karakter di tim terdekat.
Menyembuhkan Resonator yang masuk sebesar 1.54% dari Max HP Baizhi setiap 3 detik selama 30 detik. Resonator yang disembuhkan mendapatkan DMG Amplification sebesar 15% selama 6 detik.
Resonance Skill Emergency Plan memulihkan 2.5 Resonance Energy untuk setiap 1 "Concentration" yang dikonsumsi.
Jika Baizhi memiliki 4 "Concentration", Resonance Skill Emergency Plan meningkatkan  Glacio DMG Bonus sebesar 15% dan Healing Bonus sebesar 15% selama 12 detik.
Intro Skill Overflowing Frost meningkatkan Max HP Baizhi sebesar 12% selama 10 detik.
Saat Resonance Liberation Momentary Union digunakan, Resonance Liberation Remnant Entities mendapatkan efek tambahan:
- Dapat dilakukan 2 kali lebih banyak.
- Healing Multiplier meningkat 20%.
- Remnant Entities memberikan   Glacio DMG tambahan setara dengan 1.20% dari Max HP Baizhi.
Jika anggota tim tereliminasi saat Baizhi masih hidup, mereka langsung dihidupkan kembali dan dipulihkan hingga 100% Max HP. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 10 menit.
Saat Euphonia diambil, meningkatkan  Glacio DMG Bonus seluruh karakter di sekitar sebesar 12% selama 20 detik.

Info.Title: No Description Available
Info.Content:
Baizhi is a researcher in Remnant Ecoacoustics.
Baizhi's once unfulfilled wish has now manifested as her loyal companion. The Remnant Creature You'tan is her source of healing powers, and a lifelong research focus.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2190-G]

Resonator Baizhi experienced her Awakening four years ago, after being exposed to a strong Remnant Energy source one year prior. This exposure caused the activation of the corresponding Remnant frequencies within her. According to Baizhi's recounts, she experienced a strong urge to revive a teammate during her Awakening. As a result, the aforementioned frequencies manifested as a Remnant Creature that now serves as her companion.

Resonator Baizhi's Tacet Mark is located on the anterior side of her right thigh. No significant physical alterations after Awakening have been observed.

However, when exerting her Forte, the Tacet Mark emits a faint white glow with the advent of the above Remnant Creature. The creature is translucent white in color and resembles the petals of Epiphyllum. It is unable to vocalize in human language, but can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.

Resonator Baizhi cannot directly utilize her Forte, but she can leverage the extremely low temperature and her Remnant Creature's healing abilities to treat injuries in her vicinity.

Resonator Baizhi's Resonance Spectrum Pattern does not resemble any known frequencies. However, it shows a certain level of similarity with the fluctuations of Remnant Energy, and it possesses a strong Syntony Response with "You'tan," her Remnant Creature. Despite these connections, the cause of Baizhi's Awakening remains unclear without adequate theoretical evidence.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a gradual increase followed by a steep rise in its middle section. Resonator Baizhi is thus classified as a Mutant Resonator with a Dormant Period.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
The waveform graph of Baizhi illustrates an elliptical fluctuation with a stable Time Domain. No abnormal parameters are observed in the test sample.
Resonant Criticality: High. Resonator Baizhi's frequency displays high stability with currently no risk of Overclocking.
Baizhi has no documented history of Overclocking which reduces the necessity for counseling. Due to the strong bond between Baizhi and her Remnant Creature, regular examinations on the Remnant Creature's status are recommended to mitigate any potential latent risks.
